The '''Generis system''',<ref name="CSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> also known as the '''Atrivis system''', was located in the [[Atrivis sector/Legends|Atrivis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="TLCSB" /> Its primary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] was [[Generis/Legends|Generis]],<ref name="CSWE" /> and it also contained the worlds [[Atrivis]]<ref name="GFT" /> and [[Atrivis 7]].<ref name="TCD" />
